description: Creates a Stripe checkout link to add funds to the user's Spur wallet (pays for postcards, letters, SMS, enrichment and other usage beyond the plan). No money moves until the user pays on Stripe, so no confirmation is needed. If the user didn't name an amount, suggest $25, $50 or $100, or enough to cover the send they're planning.

amount_usd.description: Amount to add in US dollars (minimum $5)

name: spur_top_up_wallet
